Static file metadata and null-terminated file lists for HTTP import distribution.

# Purpose
Defines the `fd_http_static_file` record used to describe one embedded HTTP asset. The structure stores the file name and pointers to the raw, Zstandard-compressed, and gzip-compressed data, with separate length fields for each data form. The file also declares three null-terminated arrays, `STATIC_FILES_STABLE`, `STATIC_FILES_ALPHA`, and `STATIC_FILES_DEV`, which hold the static files for different build or release sets. This header does not define the data itself; it only provides the type and external declarations needed by other source files.
